service_at_issue: Advanced life support emergency ground ambulance (A0427) and mileage (A0425) from home to hospital for chest pain
outcome_note: The record showed chest pain treated and monitored en route, so other means of transport were contraindicated and the ALJ was reversed.
facts: The beneficiary was discharged from a hospital on April 17, 2011. Exh. 4, at 9. On April 17, 2011, the beneficiary was transported from her residence to a hospital. Exh. 4, at 6, 10.
The ambulance run sheet indicates that the beneficiary was alert and stable at the time of transport.

In its request for review, the appellant asserts that at the scene the beneficiary complained of active chest pain, and that the beneficiary was treated with medications to attempt to alleviate the chest pain. Exh. MAC-1. The appellant argues that it was proper for EMS to treat and transport the beneficiary, and that the transport was necessary. Id.
